_about: Skyrian's rig settings, read by tools/build_character.py. Parts are listed by position in the flat Figma export art/skyrian/Skyrian.svg (0-based, [from, to) ranges). The export has no layer names; shapeCount stops the build if it changes.
label: Skyrian
_anchor: Where he stands: the centre line of his face, robe and shoes, and his soles.
_headPivot: Under the mouth, where the beard starts: the head nods and sways about this point, and the beard and hat move with it.

wizard.label: Wizard
wizard._body_back: Collar points and cape: behind the arms, they move with the body's breathing.
wizard._arms: By screen side. The upper arm is a capsule; the shoulder pivot is the centre of its upper round end.
wizard._body: Hidden hand, collar, robe, the dark V under the beard, belt, robe skirt, hem, sash, buttons and buckle.

_head: The head's layers, back to front. Named layers are part files; pupils, lids, brows, mouth and hat are the shared face rig.

_headOutline: Beard, ears, face, mustache and hair get the white outline.

face._smile: His drawn mouth (the Mouth frame). It is his idle smile, and the shared mouth shapes are scaled and centred onto it.
face._lidColors: Skin around each eye: his face is light on the screen-left half and darker on the right.
face._lipColor: Ring around the round mouth (F): Nova's matches his muzzle; Skyrian's matches his beard.
face._minStroke: Thinnest line for the rest and closed mouths (X, A) at his size, in canvas units.
face._mouthDropY: The talking shapes sit this much lower than his drawn smile, so the mustache doesn't hide the closed and narrow ones.

_settings: Changes to tools/rig_settings.json for him only. Pupil reach is scaled to his eyes (a bigger pupil in a slightly smaller eye). Framing is only set for full body so far; the rest are Nova's sizes from the top of the hat.

settings._brows: Surprised lifts a little less than Nova's, so his brows stay clear of the hat brim.
